attention_states.NEEDS_REVIEW: Harsh should inspect the decision and may KEEP, CHANGE, BLOCK, or DEFER_TO_OWNER.
attention_states.HUMAN_REQUIRED: The affected behavior is blocked on a genuinely human-reserved decision.
attention_states.FOR_AWARENESS: Material working decision for visibility. No response is required unless Harsh wants a change.
attention_states.OWNER_DEFERRED: Harsh has deferred the decision to the Carbon owner.
attention_states.RESOLVED: A durable response or superseding repository decision has resolved this attention item.

decisions.title: Generator package ownership
decisions.question: Should the bounded generator runtime live in the carbon.generators package with the Burgers fixture isolated beneath it?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the current package ownership and one-way dependency boundary.
decisions.why: The package keeps generator authority distinct from Challenge authoring, reference truth, scoring, and later research-service ownership.
decisions.if_kept: B-03 remains a bounded generator seam that downstream B-04/B-05/B-06 work can consume without absorbing their authority.
decisions.if_changed: Package ownership, imports, code-authority rules, tests, and downstream references would need a prospective migration.

decisions.title: Exact request, event, and replay identity
decisions.question: Should generator request, event, result, and replay identities remain exact and immutable rather than ambient or mutable?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exact immutable identity and replay bindings.
decisions.why: Generator evidence must be reproducible and auditable without allowing mutable aliases or hidden retries to reinterpret history.
decisions.if_kept: Downstream evidence can bind exact generation facts.
decisions.if_changed: Canonicalization, replay, persistence, and evidence lineage would need a versioned migration.

decisions.title: Role mapping and random-material boundary
decisions.question: Should B-03 consume A4-owned random material through closed role mappings instead of owning seed or entropy authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP A4 ownership of protected random material and closed B-03 role mappings.
decisions.why: Generation should consume authorized randomness without becoming the authority that creates or discloses protected seed material.
decisions.if_kept: Seeding and generation remain separate authority domains.
decisions.if_changed: A4 leakage boundaries, B-03 request semantics, and downstream replay assumptions would need review.

decisions.title: Six terminal generator outcomes
decisions.question: Should generation keep valid generation, registered exclusion, generator nonconformance, invalid construction, censored case, and infrastructure failure as distinct outcomes?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the six-way typed outcome model.
decisions.why: Scientific failure, construction failure, censoring, exclusion, and infrastructure failure must not collapse into one candidate-failure bucket.
decisions.if_kept: B-04/B-05/B-06 can consume typed failure semantics without guessing cause.
decisions.if_changed: Failure ownership and evidence interpretation across downstream tickets would need a coordinated migration.

decisions.title: Visible attempt and successor accounting
decisions.question: Should every generation attempt remain visible with deferred successor finalization rather than silent retry or replacement?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP one visible derivation per attempt and explicit successor accounting.
decisions.why: The realized evidence population must not silently become easier than the intended sampled population.
decisions.if_kept: Later conformance and qualification work can audit intended-versus-realized evidence.
decisions.if_changed: Sampling, censoring, replacement, and qualification evidence semantics would need review.

decisions.title: Fact-only conformance and accounting
decisions.question: Should B-03 emit only factual support, censoring, accounting, and conformance evidence while leaving estimands and thresholds to later scientific authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP B-03 fact-only and leave scientific adequacy to B-05/B-06 and human-owned inputs.
decisions.why: The generator can report what happened without deciding whether the sampled population or evidence is scientifically adequate.
decisions.if_kept: Generator implementation stays mechanically useful without inventing scientific thresholds.
decisions.if_changed: Scientific authority would move into B-03 and conflict with later measurement/qualification ownership.

decisions.title: Fixed-viscosity structural Burgers fixture
decisions.question: Should Wave B use the fixed structural Burgers fixture only as a deterministic development fixture rather than a production scientific value?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the fixed-viscosity Burgers realization structurally fixture-only.
decisions.why: Wave B needs executable structure while real population, range, viscosity, sampling, and qualification values remain human-owned and unavailable.
decisions.if_kept: B-03 can support authoring and conformance tests without claiming a qualified generator.
decisions.if_changed: Real scientific values would require explicit owner/science decisions and new evidence before use.

decisions.title: Fixture provenance, disclosure, and LIVE exclusion
decisions.question: Should fixture provenance be mandatory, public disclosure remain bounded, and every fixture-derived case remain structurally unable to satisfy LIVE qualification?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP explicit fixture provenance, safe disclosure, and structural LIVE exclusion.
decisions.why: A development fixture must never be confused with qualified scientific evidence or leak protected generation material.
decisions.if_kept: The fixture remains useful for engineering while fail-closing qualification and disclosure boundaries.
decisions.if_changed: A3 LIVE gating, public projection, security, and qualification logic would need coordinated review.

decisions.title: Canonical evaluation package and one-way ownership
decisions.question: Should B-04 keep and wrap the reserved carbon.evaluation namespace with one-way dependencies instead of creating a new reference owner or absorbing generator, scoring, registry, or qualification authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP + WRAP carbon.evaluation as B-04's package boundary and preserve one-way ownership.
decisions.why: The namespace is already the installed-wheel and code-authority seam for reference work, while a new package or placement under another domain would duplicate or collapse ownership.
decisions.if_kept: B-05, B-06, B-07F, and B-E2 can consume narrow named seams without granting B-04 their measurement, qualification, fixture-consumer, or expanded-runtime authority.
decisions.if_changed: Package ownership, imports, code-authority rules, exports, and downstream references would require a prospective migration before runtime types exist.

decisions.title: Canonical identity, refs, and prospective history
decisions.question: Should B-04 reserve a distinct v1 identity and ref inventory with strict canonicalization, immutable historical interpretation, and a separate exact-schema freeze before runtime?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the distinct v1 identity/ref inventory, strict canonical requirements, prospective versioning, and required B-04-D11 freeze before runtime.
decisions.why: Reference policy, grants, runs, artifacts, comparisons, admission, and assets must bind every meaning-bearing identity without mutable aliases, ambient serialization, coercion, or latest-version lookup.
decisions.if_kept: B-05 and B-06 can consume stable refs, while B-E2 can test stale and cross-binding responses against immutable history.
decisions.if_changed: Canonical profiles, field registries, refs, consumers, and migration rules would change prospectively while historical bytes and their interpretation remain unchanged.

decisions.title: Separate evidence, authority, source, and composition axes
decisions.question: Should evidence kind, scientific authority function, source class, and target composition remain separate closed axes with exact policy containment and primary/witness disjointness?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the orthogonal closed axes, exact membership rules, and separate SINGLE_ENTRY or REGISTERED_HYBRID_POLICY composition.
decisions.why: Analytic, numerical, experimental, industrial, surrogate, and hybrid labels describe evidence or source form rather than scientific authority and cannot safely substitute for registered primary or witness roles.
decisions.if_kept: B-05 can consume exact evidence meaning, B-06 can retain limitations, and B-E2/B-E3 can test and render role boundaries without source-count voting or self-promotion.
decisions.if_changed: Role, source, composition, policy, canonicalization, comparison, and downstream evidence contracts would need a prospective coordinated migration.

decisions.title: Policy-issued nominal primary and witness runner grants
decisions.question: Should nominal primary and witness requests, grants, runners, and outcomes remain separate, with trusted policy resolution binding an exact one-use grant before execution?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP separate nominal primary/witness paths, exact policy resolution, one-use grants, and no generic truth mode.
decisions.why: Caller-selected solvers, tolerances, payloads, paths, code, retries, or fixture flags would let execution choose or widen scientific authority.
decisions.if_kept: B-07F can consume minimal fixture assets and B-E2 can own Julia/service adapters and expanded runtime failures without making runners the policy authority.
decisions.if_changed: Runner families, policy resolution, grant identity, provider boundaries, failure outcomes, and downstream adapters would require new prospective types and policies.

decisions.title: Total run and comparison outcomes with failure attribution
decisions.question: Should reference runs and comparisons use closed total outcomes, subordinate reasons, deterministic precedence, and the unchanged B-02A reference-censoring eligibility map?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP total typed run/comparison outcomes, deterministic reason precedence, infrastructure-safe ambiguity, and exact B-02A censoring eligibility.
decisions.why: Missing, unresolved, contested, numerical, malformed, infrastructure, capacity, timeout, cancellation, and supported states must not collapse into candidate failure, score zero, or a partial answer.
decisions.if_kept: B-02A receives only eligible exact terminal facts, B-05 rejects unsupported material, and B-E2 can prove the complete runtime matrix.
decisions.if_changed: Every producer and consumer of terminal outcomes, comparison facts, censoring eligibility, and evidence admission would require an exhaustive prospective migration.

decisions.title: Positive-only TruthAsset admission and distinct fixture assets
decisions.question: Should a ReferenceArtifact become a TruthAsset only through a separate positive admission authority and exact eligible graph, while fixture output remains a distinct non-promotable asset?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP positive-only TruthAsset admission, separate grant issuance and substantive admission, exact rejection for absence or ineligibility, and structurally distinct FixtureReferenceAsset output.
decisions.why: Solver success, artifact presence, fixture provenance, booleans, wrappers, or self-admission cannot create answer-key authority or qualified evidence.
decisions.if_kept: B-05 consumes only admitted refs, B-06 owns qualification evidence, B-07F consumes fixture assets, and B-E2 cannot manufacture admission authority.
decisions.if_changed: Admission authority, capability issuance, artifact eligibility, qualification, fixture separation, disclosure, and downstream consumers would require a high-cost prospective science/security migration.

decisions.title: Explicit support, applicability, conditioning, and uncertainty
decisions.question: Should support, applicability, conditioning, and uncertainty remain case-level exact evidence bindings with no invented numeric floor, threshold, independence, or transfer assumption?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP explicit evidence-bound support, applicability, conditioning, uncertainty, dependence, limitations, and downstream-use restrictions without production numeric values.
decisions.why: Envelope labels, convergence, residuals, solver tolerances, mesh size, or witness differences do not by themselves establish applicability, conditioning, uncertainty, or independence.
decisions.if_kept: B-05 can own propagation and decision use, B-06 can qualify coverage and dependence, and B-E1 can test joint decision resolution while unsupported cases remain visible.
decisions.if_changed: Support policies, uncertainty identities, evidence applicability, measurement use, qualification, and historical evidence would require new versions and requalification.

decisions.title: Correlation disclosure, contested disagreement, and no fallback
decisions.question: Should material shared and distinct source paths be disclosed, disagreement remain contested or indeterminate, and fallback remain unavailable unless prospectively registered and qualified?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP explicit correlation disclosure, contested disagreement, no averaging, and no registered fallback.
decisions.why: Implementation labels, multi-code agreement, voting, averaging, assumed independence, or convenient fallback can hide common bias and silently change the answer-key contract.
decisions.if_kept: B-05/B-E1 can apply dependence-aware use, B-06 can retain evidence and limitations, and B-E2 can test disagreement and failure without converting them into candidate failure.
decisions.if_changed: Comparison, correlation, fallback, qualification, policy versioning, and historical evidence would require a prospective policy and requalification.

decisions.title: Complete provenance, cache identity, and protected disclosure
decisions.question: Should every meaning-bearing identity enter run and cache identity, every cache hit revalidate the full graph, and all raw reference material remain protected unless positively allow-listed?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP complete provenance and cache binding, full-graph hit validation, protected-by-default records, and positive allow-list public projection.
decisions.why: Partial keys, mutable tags, stale hits, paths, generic serialization, redaction after serialization, and diagnostics can substitute meaning or disclose protected answer-key material.
decisions.if_kept: B-06 can own retained qualification evidence, B-07F receives fixture-only projections, and later real cache and service owners can operate without widening disclosure.
decisions.if_changed: Cache identity, provenance, public projection, access, rights, security, operations, and every consumer would require explicit versioned review and migration.

decisions.title: Preserve B-02A censoring and downstream owner boundaries
decisions.question: Should B-04 supply exact reference facts through existing B-02A censoring semantics while leaving case lifecycle, measurement, qualification, fixture consumption, expanded adapters, and later authority with their named owners?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the existing B-02A censoring model and one-way downstream owner boundaries; B-04 creates no second lifecycle, score, gate, Dossier, LIVE, product, frontier, or settlement path.
decisions.why: B-02A and B-03 already own canonical case and intended-versus-realized accounting, while B-05, B-06, B-07F, B-E1, B-E2, and B-E3 have explicit non-substitutable responsibilities.
decisions.if_kept: Reference and infrastructure failures remain distinct from candidate science, and each downstream ticket consumes only its authorized exact seam.
decisions.if_changed: Case lifecycle, censoring, measurement, qualification, fixture, adapter, LIVE, product, frontier, and economic owners would require a high-cost coordinated migration.

decisions.title: Repository-owned development throughput and delivery proof
decisions.question: Should Carbon make repository-owned canonical execution, path-aware CI, exact-head review, guarded merge policy, and external completion receipts the default delivery system before B-04 runtime resumes?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the OWNER-DX-01 delivery system and its fail-closed exact-identity boundaries.
decisions.why: A single repository-owned path reduces workstation drift, avoidable reruns, generated-output fan-out, stale pull-request declarations, and unverifiable completion claims without transferring scientific or production authority to automation.
decisions.if_kept: B-01G and resumed B-04 work inherit one canonical validation path, a stable Merge gate, explicit review and merge evidence, and bounded Development Hub updates.
decisions.if_changed: Canonical execution, CI classification, branch protection, receipt authority, agent delivery protocol, and downstream ticket launch requirements would need a coordinated prospective migration.

decisions.title: Post-Wave-B Bittensor and treasury-before-mainnet roadmap
decisions.question: Should Carbon preserve Wave B, begin real Bittensor integration only afterward, prove temporary direct weights on testnet, and require frontier-backed treasury settlement before mainnet economic activation?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP OWNER-NET-01's C0/C1/C2, D-to-H-to-I, typed-intent, no-winner-sink, validator-evidence, and treasury-before-mainnet roadmap.
decisions.why: The roadmap proves network integration without letting Bittensor objects, raw score magnitude, stale winners, test fixtures, or direct mainnet winner weights acquire scientific or production economic authority.
decisions.if_kept: Wave B remains unchanged; G3 stays non-LIVE and non-settling; Wave D qualifies the first Challenge; Wave H alone creates frontier events; and Wave I must qualify treasury routing and settlement before mainnet activation.
decisions.if_changed: Launch taxonomy, network/science boundaries, typed intents, no-winner behavior, frontier sequencing, treasury custody and settlement, validator economics, migration evidence, and affected authority documents require a prospective owner-reviewed supersession.

decisions.title: Exact v1 executable reference schema and protected surface
decisions.question: Should B-04 freeze the exact closed v1 record/ref registry, subordinate schemas, outcome/reason and absence matrices, canonical framing, root exports, and protected types before its first runtime model?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the recorded B-04-D11 v1 schema, compatibility matrices, one-to-one ref registry, audience-safe root tuple, and protected submodule boundary.
decisions.why: A complete pre-runtime freeze prevents role, identity, absence, provenance, artifact, admission, or public-surface ambiguity while preserving the ratified B-04-D1 through B-04-D10 meaning.
decisions.if_kept: B-04 can implement deterministic fixture-only policy, execution, comparison, artifact, admission, and disclosure paths while B-05, B-06, B-07F, and B-E2 consume only their authorized seams.
decisions.if_changed: Supersede B-04-D11 and prospectively update every affected schema field/type/order, ref mapping, compatibility test, protected/public boundary, and downstream consumer without reinterpreting merged v1 history.

decisions.title: At-most-once admission-authority invocation across the callback boundary
decisions.question: Should the one-use admission grant remain consumed after callback start even when the provider raises, is cancelled, or returns an invalid echo without producing a decision?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP complete pre-callback validation and reversible inspection, atomically consume immediately before the saved callback with no post-boundary rollback, and replace non-Exception provider control flow with one fixed protected signal outside provider context.
decisions.why: The ratified contract permits one exact attempt and selects no retry or durable idempotency policy; rollback could duplicate an unknowable external effect, while the original provider signal could disclose protected text, arguments, context, or traceback frames.
decisions.if_kept: Provider or post-callback failure creates no decision or TruthAsset, hostile control signals expose no provider payload and create no outcome, and every reentrant, concurrent, or later reuse fails locally before a second callback.
decisions.if_changed: A resumable design requires a prospective grant and service version, durable attempt identity, authority-side idempotency evidence, reconciliation states, and explicit operations and security ownership.

decisions.title: Manual Codex/GPT review plus distinct human approval
decisions.question: Should Carbon replace the inaccessible Greptile workspace with fresh complete-diff Codex/GPT review, a closed exact-head receipt, and distinct non-author human approval?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP GOV-REVIEW-01-D1 and its protected GPT review gate, stale-approval dismissal, last-push approval, resolved-thread, normal-merge, and no-bypass controls.
decisions.why: The owner-selected process preserves exact-head review and finding accountability without depending on an inaccessible third-party workspace or adding an automated model API secret and billing dependency.
decisions.if_kept: B-04 and later tickets receive one exact-head model-review record plus an attributable non-author human approval, while all scientific and other reserved authority stays separate and fail closed.
decisions.if_changed: Delivery protocol, receipt schema, review workflow and validator, ruleset artifact and live state, ticket gates, tests, and external completion evidence require a coordinated prospective migration.

decisions.title: Carbon Iterative Agent Harness Pilot
decisions.question: Should Carbon interpose a bounded identity-bound Planner/Developer/Tester controller after completed B-04 and before B-05 without changing B-05 science or final delivery authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP OWNER-DX-02 and B-01H-D1 through B-01H-D6: deterministic controller advancement, exact identities, manifest-authorized evidence independently replayed by the controller, regression-first replanning, sanitized role projections, audited progressive disclosure, and delivery-protocol-only final handoff.
decisions.why: PR #75 completed B-04 and selected B-05 but explicitly recorded B-05 as not started, allowing the development-system interposition without rewriting scientific requirements or historical evidence.
decisions.if_kept: B-01H can complete only in bounded development-tooling scope, after which B-05 becomes the active first pilot from the receipt-recorded exact main while all scientific and later authority remains human-owned and fail closed.
decisions.if_changed: Update OWNER-DX-02 and the B-01H ticket, plan, role boundaries, schemas, tests, Hub sequencing, and B-05 pilot mapping prospectively before relying on the affected controller behavior.

decisions.title: Challenge-bound measurement package with unchanged A5
decisions.question: Should B-05 own an independent canonical measurement package while A5 remains the unchanged deterministic scalar executor?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the standard-library-only carbon.measurement package, its separate canonical domain, and one-way public upstream imports; do not widen B-02A/B-04 or let B-05 construct ScoreInput.
decisions.why: Independent identity preserves measurement history and prevents authoring, truth, resource, and scoring authority from collapsing into one runtime.
decisions.if_kept: B-06 and B-07F can consume exact measurement refs while A5 continues to execute only its closed fixture scalar contract.
decisions.if_changed: The namespace, canonical profile, code-authority entry, public refs, persisted fixture pins, tests, and downstream imports require a versioned migration.

decisions.title: Explicit measurement evidence-role and claim matrix
decisions.question: Should evidence claims be structurally limited so MMS and implementation verification cannot stand in for physical validation or context of use?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP separate MeasurementContract and qualification-evidence identities with explicit supported and unsupported claims under a closed role matrix.
decisions.why: Free text and solver agreement cannot stop implementation evidence from acquiring authority it does not possess.
decisions.if_kept: Only separately identified experimental or industrial evidence can be eligible to support physical validity, target-workload applicability, or engineering context of use; B-06 still decides qualification.
decisions.if_changed: The evidence enums, compatibility matrix, canonical bytes, fixtures, B-06 consumer, and role-confusion tests require a schema migration.

decisions.title: Exact A5 input use with mandatory admissibility first
decisions.question: Should every A5 scalar key have an exact qualified measurement-use binding with all mandatory material admitted before aggregation?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exact pack-key coverage and mandatory-first admissibility; reject generic metric dictionaries, diagnostics relabeled as score material, and resource, mock, product, chain, or commercial inputs.
decisions.why: A finite scalar shape alone proves neither scientific origin nor admissibility, and soft score cannot compensate for a mandatory gap.
decisions.if_kept: B-07F receives a closed scalar projection but remains the owner of official ScoreInput construction and A5 invocation.
decisions.if_changed: Score-use records, pack coverage, projection precedence, B-07F integration, forbidden-input tests, and possibly A5 authority require coordinated review.

decisions.title: Exact dependence policy before covariance shortcuts
decisions.question: Should quadrature, independence, or zero-covariance shortcuts require exact Dossier applicability to the incumbent and challenger evidence being compared?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exact dependence, pairing, resampling, interaction, censoring, minima, stopping, and error-control refs; return UNCERTAINTY_UNRESOLVED on missing or scope-mismatched shortcut evidence.
decisions.why: Separate seeds, processes, solvers, or machines do not establish independence and can materially change comparison conclusions.
decisions.if_kept: B-06 owns the positive Dossier applicability decision and B-E1 can test dependence-aware coverage without B-05 guessing covariance.
decisions.if_changed: The uncertainty policy, Dossier binding, comparison consumer, canonical schema, and statistical tests require a prospective version.

decisions.title: Scientific reconstruction stages separate from resource facts
decisions.question: Should B-05 own complete-base, nomination, extension, promotion, stopping, stability, and deferred evidence policy while B-02C receipts remain resource facts only?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP distinct scientific stages, typed EVIDENCE_DEFERRED, and non-authoritative heuristic-futility advice; do not let B-02C facts establish sufficiency or candidate failure.
decisions.why: Resource completion or exhaustion does not prove scientific coverage, and nomination is not promotion.
decisions.if_kept: B-E1 tests coverage and false elimination against B-05-authored policy while B-02C remains a clean resource prerequisite.
decisions.if_changed: Reconstruction stage records, B-02C adapters, B-E1 harness assumptions, stopping outcomes, canonical bytes, and tests require migration.

decisions.title: Closed no-scalar outcomes for non-admissible material
decisions.question: Should every partial, non-finite, inapplicable, reference-failed, floor/uncertainty/qualification-unresolved, or deferred result carry a typed no-scalar outcome?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the closed outcome family and fixed fail-closed precedence; only COMPLETE material may carry a scalar and it still requires exact scope and qualification checks.
decisions.why: Nulls, sentinel floats, zero filling, or generic invalid states can turn infrastructure or evidence gaps into rank-changing scientific values.
decisions.if_kept: B-07F can exhaustively accept only admissible complete projections without interpreting missing data.
decisions.if_changed: The material union, canonical registry, projection, B-07F/B-E1 exhaustiveness, disclosure, and tests require a new schema version.

decisions.title: Acyclic uncertainty identity and exact scalar prerequisites
decisions.question: Should the unmerged B-05 candidate use an exact acyclic uncertainty graph and require matching construction identity plus resolved floor and uncertainty authority before scalar exposure?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP policy-to-measurement-to-Score-Pack identity, exact plan/policy/class matching for reconstruction facts, and typed no-scalar outcomes for human-input or blocked floor and uncertainty authority.
decisions.why: Reverse content-digest edges are unconstructable, Challenge-only matching permits evidence borrowing, and caller-labeled complete material cannot supply missing scientific authority.
decisions.if_kept: B-05 retains exact content identity and fail-closed scalar projection without inventing floors, independence, covariance, minima, stopping rules, or qualification.
decisions.if_changed: The candidate canonical payload, fixed vectors, reconstruction fact graph, measurement selection, Score Pack binding, projection precedence, and downstream consumers require coordinated migration.

decisions.title: Owner-directed advancement from merged B-05
decisions.question: Should B-06 begin from merged PR #87 without another B-05 review loop while preserving the incomplete ordinary delivery record?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the narrow owner-directed transition: accept the exact merged B-05 tree as this dependency, retain B-05 in_progress as a factual delivery state, and change no future delivery rule.
decisions.why: This follows explicit owner sequencing without inventing reviews, approval, CI, receipts, or broader qualification authority.
decisions.if_kept: B-06 bounded development proceeds from exact main 2500e510 and tree 89763523; no active B-05 work is required.
decisions.if_changed: The Wave selection, dependency status, Hub event, and B-06 opening evidence require a prospective owner correction; historical PR facts remain unchanged.

decisions.title: Exact deterministic Dossier identity
decisions.question: Should B-06 isolate exact Dossier identity in carbon.qualification while leaving the active A3 registry and LIVE gate unchanged?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the standard-library-only package, exact Challenge binding, distinct canonical domain, strict decode, and one-way dependency on public identity primitives.
decisions.why: A validation evidence record needs independent deterministic history without becoming an activation record or changing completed upstream schemas.
decisions.if_kept: Later B-06 slices can compare an exact Dossier ref against A3 through an explicit adapter without creating a parallel registry.
decisions.if_changed: The package, schema/profile, canonical bytes, refs, tests, authority map, and future comparator require versioned migration.

decisions.title: D1-D12 structural completeness and non-substitution
decisions.question: Should every required D1-D12 slot require its own primary evidence class while campaign evidence remains supplemental and completeness remains separate from scientific status?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exact ordered slots, slot-specific primary classes, explicit missing/placeholder/complete states, and rejection of MMS or cross-slot evidence as a substitute.
decisions.why: A populated template or successful verification campaign does not establish physical, population, reference, measurement, statistical, customer-context, or LIVE adequacy.
decisions.if_kept: B-E1 can later supply campaign evidence while humans retain adequacy and coverage judgments for each exact section.
decisions.if_changed: The closed slot/evidence map, canonical profile, evidence manifests, cross-section rules, and focused tests require coordinated migration.

decisions.title: Required signer roles remain populated-unverified
decisions.question: Should the first Dossier slice bind exact B-06 signer roles and typed artifacts without representing verified authority or approval?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exactly Physics/SciML, statistics, protocol, security, and independent-review bindings with only REQUIRED_MISSING or POPULATED_UNVERIFIED state.
decisions.why: A signer name, signature byte string, populated slot, or authorization-evidence link does not prove identity, key custody, role authority, or valid approval.
decisions.if_kept: A later manifest comparator must consume externally verified authorization and the exact active A3 record; no fixture or structural path can qualify a real Challenge.
decisions.if_changed: Signer-role identity, artifact kinds, canonical bytes, authorization integration, and negative tests require a prospective schema update.

decisions.title: Exact upstream evidence seams and explicit claim mappings
decisions.question: Should B-06 pin exact evidence subjects through existing B-02A/B-05 refs and require explicit closed evidence-to-claim mappings?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the exact subject graph, B-03/B-04 owner-ref seams, and source-backed one-to-many claim mappings without implicit cross-section support.
decisions.why: Challenge-only joins admit stale or wrong-object evidence, while direct B-03/B-04 imports reverse completed package boundaries and generic evidence claims permit unsafe substitution.
decisions.if_kept: Population, SamplingPlan, generator, reference, representation, measurement, and claim scope remain exact and separately reviewable; compatibility does not imply adequacy.
decisions.if_changed: The evidence-manifest profile, upstream seam, closed matrix, canonical bytes, and negative tests require coordinated prospective migration.

decisions.title: Dependence structure remains pending owner ratification
decisions.question: May the v2.1/v4.1 dependence proposal be treated as accepted scientific policy merely because B-06 carries its structural identities?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP only OWNER_RATIFICATION_PENDING until Physics/SciML, statistics, and protocol owners ratify the scientific policy; structural completeness grants no method, independence, or coverage acceptance.
decisions.why: Generator_Validation v2.1 and scientific canon v4.1 explicitly preserve v2.0/v4 as ratified authority pending named-owner acceptance.
decisions.if_kept: Unrelated structural work proceeds, while positive dependence-policy and scientific qualification behavior remains unavailable.
decisions.if_changed: A durable owner ratification must prospectively define the accepted policy/result state and its review evidence before B-06 can implement it.

decisions.title: Opaque accounting, secrecy, and scoped limitations
decisions.question: Should B-06 preserve distinct attempt outcomes and exact limitation scope without embedding protected data or automatically changing the registered envelope?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP opaque exact refs, distinct generator/reference/infrastructure/candidate dispositions, separate D11 audit roles, and non-mutating limitation bindings.
decisions.why: Collapsed failure labels distort scientific evidence, embedded protected material creates disclosure risk, and a limitation record has no authority to rewrite the task.
decisions.if_kept: Reviewers see exact intended/realized provenance and affected scope while security, censoring adequacy, and residual-risk acceptance stay human-owned.
decisions.if_changed: Accounting enums, protected-field boundaries, limitation semantics, canonical bytes, and disclosure tests require prospective review.

decisions.title: Pure A3 snapshot comparison without registry lifecycle authority
decisions.question: Should B-06 reuse only A3's immutable public values and require the caller to supply one exact record snapshot?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP/WRAP A3 ChallengeRecord, QualificationManifest, QualificationEvidence, ArtifactBinding, and required slot values without importing its store or gate.
decisions.why: B-06 needs exact integration evidence without gaining registry lookup, artifact-byte verification, mutation, or activation authority.
decisions.if_kept: The comparator stays deterministic and side-effect free; A3 remains the sole lifecycle owner.
decisions.if_changed: Any store/gate integration requires a prospective owner-approved adapter and renewed authority, disclosure, and lifecycle review.

decisions.title: Domain-separated candidate and A3 snapshot fingerprints
decisions.question: How should B-06 detect exact A3 qualification snapshot drift when A3 exposes no manifest-digest API?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP distinct versioned domains for B-06 candidate identity, artifact-set identity, and the exact public A3 qualification snapshot fingerprint.
decisions.why: A separate fingerprint detects field drift without falsely naming a B-06 digest as A3's qualification hash or an approval token.
decisions.if_kept: Exact snapshot, slot, artifact, authoring-graph, dossier, and measurement comparisons remain independently visible and non-authorizing.
decisions.if_changed: The candidate schema/profile and historical bytes require prospective migration, and any A3-owned digest must come from A3 authority.

decisions.title: External signer results remain distinct from approval
decisions.question: How should B-06 consume signer checks without inventing identity, role, cryptographic, quorum, or scientific authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP signer-slot population, identity structural validation, exact-role authorization, signature verification, and scientific approval as separate facts; represent only the first four and fail closed when external results are absent or unverified.
decisions.why: A signer name or populated signature slot cannot establish authorization, valid cryptography, or scientific acceptance.
decisions.if_kept: A trusted external layer can later supply exact per-role results while B-06 remains a structural consumer and never a signer or approver.
decisions.if_changed: Trust roots, role policy, cryptography, quorum, and scientific signoff require explicit human/security authority before any new state is added.

decisions.title: Decision-resolution evidence stays pending and execution-free
decisions.question: How can B-06 represent decision-resolution evidence without ratifying the v2.1 dependence proposal or implementing B-E1's engine?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exact decision-method, dependence, coverage, censoring, stopping-audit, result, and limitation identities only under OWNER_RATIFICATION_PENDING, with no calculation or accepted-policy state.
decisions.why: The active ticket needs the structural evidence seam, but Generator Validation v2.1 and scientific-canon v4.1 explicitly remain owner-ratification proposals and B-E1 owns execution.
decisions.if_kept: B-06 can preserve future evidence exactly while dependence policy, statistical adequacy, and promotion remain unavailable until separately authorized.
decisions.if_changed: A durable owner ratification and B-E1 implementation authority are required before any accepted dependence policy or computed decision behavior can be added.

decisions.title: Campaign outcomes remain observations, not qualification
decisions.question: How should campaign results preserve distinct outcomes without turning their presence into evidence adequacy or candidate failure?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP a closed family-compatible outcome vocabulary, exact acquisition/scope binding, separate upstream failure categories, and fail-closed projection of unusable outcomes.
decisions.why: Free text, passed booleans, or implicit failure conversion would transfer scientific authority and collapse reference or generator failures into candidate failures.
decisions.if_kept: Reviewers receive exact observations and failure classes while scientific sufficiency and qualification remain human-owned.
decisions.if_changed: Outcome enums, canonical bytes, evidence projection, failure accounting, and non-substitution tests require prospective migration.

decisions.title: Closed campaign manifests without campaign engines
decisions.question: Should B-06 use one composable acquisition/result manifest architecture for the eight campaign families without executing or judging them?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the separately canonicalized campaign domain, family-specific subject/definition/artifact matrices, exact result identity, and existing evidence-claim projection path.
decisions.why: Separate one-off schemas duplicate identity logic, while an opaque bag erases scientific distinctions; either design would weaken fail-closed review.
decisions.if_kept: All ticket-named campaign evidence can be represented and tested without adding thresholds, engines, scientific verdicts, registry mutation, or LIVE authority.
decisions.if_changed: The campaign profile, family matrices, result identity, canonical bytes, Dossier evidence refs, and downstream consumers require versioned migration.

decisions.title: Wrap B-06 with a non-authorizing crosswalk
decisions.question: How should B-E3 bind every Dossier claim to evidence without creating a competing evidence or qualification system?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP B-06 claim, evidence, manifest, Challenge, origin, and canonical identities authoritative and add one separately framed pure crosswalk assessment and report layer.
decisions.why: A parallel store would split authority, while free-form mapping could silently accept stale identities or role substitution.
decisions.if_kept: B-E3 can validate exact caller-supplied B-06 manifests and remain incapable of scientific adjudication, registry mutation, campaign execution, or LIVE activation.
decisions.if_changed: The v1 crosswalk profile, package surface, canonical bytes, reports, tests, and downstream B-GATE consumers require a prospective migration.

decisions.title: Structural MMS and audience-disclosure boundaries
decisions.question: How should B-E3 prevent MMS substitution and protected-identity leakage while keeping absent evidence visible?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP a closed source-kind claim matrix, hard MMS boundary, exact category/maturity map, required-input failure, and positive audience allow-lists with value-free errors.
decisions.why: Deny-list redaction, caller approval flags, or generic evidence categories would permit leakage, self-certification, or maturity escalation.
decisions.if_kept: Pending and absent evidence remains explicit but non-satisfying, while protected source and reconstruction-sensitive identities stay out of lower-audience reports and errors.
decisions.if_changed: The schema/profile, source matrix, disclosure projections, tests, and downstream report consumers require a prospective migration plus the relevant human authority.

decisions.title: Exact bounded local v2 protocol
decisions.question: How should every later B-07 implementation share one interoperable local wire, task, prior, fixture-capability, and ownership contract without acquiring official evaluator authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP disjoint carbon_protocol_v1/carbon_research_v2 namespaces, exact bounded v2 types and errors, linearizable task semantics, acyclic prior/index identities, nominal public/fixture contexts, and B-07G composition-only.
decisions.why: B-07R delegated these mechanics to B-07S; leaving them to downstream tickets would permit incompatible identities, caller-selected authority, ambiguous races, or duplicate semantic ownership.
decisions.if_kept: B-07A-G can implement against one exact fail-closed protocol while existing A2/A7/B-02A/B/C identities and the official v1 lifecycle remain authoritative.
decisions.if_changed: The affected normative protocol section, conformance manifest/test, decision record, and downstream implementation contracts require a new version and owner-specific migration.

decisions.title: One exact v2 core and bounded discovery
decisions.question: How should B-07A implement the shared v2 vocabulary and discovery without creating a second manifest schema or absorbing later operation owners?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP one carbon.research owner, the sole ratified InteractionManifest wire name, immutable exact-version discovery, and local execution of only the two B-07A operations with every later operation explicitly unavailable.
decisions.why: Duplicate types, latest-version aliases, successful stubs, caller-selected capabilities, or a broad dispatcher would break nominal history or transfer authority from later tickets.
decisions.if_kept: Downstream tickets import one exact core while B-07A remains a bounded public discovery layer that changes neither official v1 nor qualification state.
decisions.if_changed: Wire names, package ownership, historical canonical bytes, ref digests, provider boundaries, runtime tests, and downstream imports require a prospective protocol version and migration.

decisions.title: Linearizable local research records
decisions.question: How should B-07B implement exact task races and useful private evidence records without widening the frozen wire contract or acquiring later-owner and human-reserved authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP one constructor-bound linearizable local provider, canonical detached start and transactional pins, private non-wire ExperimentRecords, resolved-plan-derived differences, positive allow-list receipts, and local-only retention unless an exact rights authorization exists.
decisions.why: Mutable/latest bindings, poll-driven execution, raw executor findings, implicit evidence promotion, or private wire aliases would break B-07S identity and race semantics or transfer scientific, security, and rights authority.
decisions.if_kept: Later B-07 tickets can compose practice, prior, resource, and dispatch owners around stable task/receipt identities while official v1 and qualification remain unchanged.
decisions.if_changed: Task/receipt identity, state, cancellation, polling, private record schemas, disclosure, tests, and downstream consumers require the relevant versioned migration and human authority.

decisions.title: One prospective B-05 then B-07C delivery
decisions.question: How should Carbon finish B-05 as B-07C's prerequisite without replaying the delivery ceremony superseded by OWNER-DX-03?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP current verification of B-05's substantive Definition of Done, prospective bounded closeout, then B-07C implementation on the same candidate while B-07D1 remains todo and unstarted.
decisions.why: The owner selected this order and packaging; current code and tests establish the substantive dependency, while inventing missing historical review or receipt facts would be false.
decisions.if_kept: One accepted normal merge closes B-05 only in verified engineering scope and B-07C only in fixture scope, preserving every scientific and security ceiling.
decisions.if_changed: The two Wave registers, both tickets/evidence records, Hub current state, and combined PR packaging must be superseded prospectively.

decisions.title: Nominal mock-only practice behind B-07B
decisions.question: How should B-07C execute useful fixture practice without widening the wire contract or acquiring official evaluator authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP one carbon.practice executor with exact versioned mock packs, A4 mock-only role-separated draws, B-02B resolved plans, B-02C resource receipt refs, and B-07B lifecycle and receipt ownership.
decisions.why: A second dispatcher or record system would split ownership, while official entropy, A5, new wire aliases, or canned outcomes would violate the ticket boundary.
decisions.if_kept: All four task kinds execute coherently in-process with private case material, bounded registered findings, typed failures, and no official promotion path.
decisions.if_changed: The practice contract/profile, package modules, narrow B-07B private adapters, tests, and later B-07E/B-07G consumers require a prospective migration.

decisions.title: One ordered prior delivery with separate evidence
decisions.question: How should the three sequential prior tickets be delivered without erasing their boundaries?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP B-07D1 then B-07D2 then B-07D3 on one branch and PR while retaining separate Definitions of Done and evidence.
decisions.why: The dependencies are sequential but do not require three merge ceremonies, and grouping grants no additional scientific, security, publication, rights, or production authority.
decisions.if_kept: One accepted candidate can close all three bounded scopes while leaving B-07E todo and unstarted.
decisions.if_changed: The Wave register, three ticket/evidence records, candidate packaging, and Hub state require prospective reconciliation.

decisions.title: Reuse the ratified pack and isolate private v1 projection
decisions.question: How should immutable prior storage and compatibility reuse existing authorities?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP B-07S PriorPack and canonical encoding exact, store authorization and history privately, and keep the lossy v1 projection offline with no provider installation.
decisions.why: A second wire schema, serializer, or v2-backed v1 provider would split identity and widen service authority.
decisions.if_kept: D1 supplies immutable auditable history and explicit authorization seams without public publication or production signing authority.
decisions.if_changed: Prior identities, canonical bytes, storage, compatibility receipts, and downstream D2/D3 consumers require a prospective migration.

decisions.title: Authorize exact synthetic bytes with one durable commit
decisions.question: How should TEST_ONLY fixture publication bind checks, authority, and disclosure history?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP synthetic-only construction, exact-byte structural checks, B-07R-D8 exact-hash fixture authorization, and one atomic ledger/receipt/snapshot commit.
decisions.why: In-memory accounting or split commits permit differencing loss, authorization mismatch, and partial publication under races.
decisions.if_kept: Fixture releases remain persistent, auditable, TEST_ONLY, NOT_UTILITY_QUALIFIED, and incapable of public activation.
decisions.if_changed: Publisher policy, ledger schema, receipt identity, atomicity tests, and future public-branch specifications require review and migration.

decisions.title: Separate nominal public and fixture static providers
decisions.question: How should authorized public and fixture retrieval remain structurally separate?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP separate concrete provider classes, private nominal fixture construction, exact receipt/ledger binding, atomic active reads, B-07B run pins, and deterministic structural-only alignment.
decisions.why: Caller booleans, mode strings, personalization, or mutable latest aliases would permit authority crossing or task reinterpretation.
decisions.if_kept: Every authorized requester receives identical exact bytes, fixtures remain private exact-ref only, and alignment predicts no official outcome.
decisions.if_changed: Provider constructors, authorization validation, task pinning, alignment, and B-07E/B-07G integrations require prospective migration.

decisions.title: Exact static projection and fail-closed forecast provenance
decisions.question: How should B-07E provide useful resource information when the ratified wire has no explicit support fields and no authorized real calibration exists?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP exact B-02B/B-02C-backed static projection, preserve the B-07S wire, make the ordinary provider accept no calibration and return UNRESOLVED, and isolate synthetic calibration mechanics behind a distinct TEST_ONLY constructor.
decisions.why: Invented calibration or new wire fields would exceed authority, while a general provider that accepts fixtures could launder TEST_ONLY material into a production-shaped path.
decisions.if_kept: B-07E supplies deterministic exact inspection and a complete fail-closed forecast seam while quote, receipt, scoring, production calibration, and qualification ownership remain separate.
decisions.if_changed: Forecast wire versioning, provider constructors, provenance bindings, tests, and later B-07G composition require a prospective migration and the relevant owner authority.

decisions.title: Consume the registered sampling lever in a separate fixture adapter
decisions.question: How should a canonical resolved plan enter the existing official-shaped fixture lifecycle without mutating A8 or widening authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP A7, the frozen A8 stub, A5 scoring, B-02B compilation, and B-02C assessment exact; add one separate fixture-only provider that consumes canonical fixture_sampling_level and binds private reconstruction/result receipts.
decisions.why: A separate nominal consumer proves plan responsiveness and parity while preventing caller labels, raw Strategy branching, mock or provider-origin entropy, and fixture outputs from laundering authority.
decisions.if_kept: B-07F supplies deterministic fixed-toy integration evidence for B-E4 and B-GATE without granting real reconstruction, scientific, security, rights, production, or LIVE authority.
decisions.if_changed: The adapter contract, registered lever semantics, receipt identity, A7/A8 compatibility tests, and downstream parity evidence require prospective review and migration.

decisions.title: One downstream fixture reproducibility package
decisions.question: Where should B-E1 mechanics live without duplicating B-02A/B/B-04/B-05 authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP one additive carbon.reproducibility package with one-way imports from exact upstream identities and policies.
decisions.why: A downstream wrapper preserves each established owner while giving B-E1 one bounded fixture API and authority root.
decisions.if_kept: B-E4 and B-GATE can consume deterministic fixture evidence without changing upstream schemas or public services.
decisions.if_changed: Package ownership, code-authority rules, canonical identity, imports, tests, and downstream consumers require a prospective migration.

decisions.title: Separate nominal R0 R1 and R2 results
decisions.question: How should exact identity, numerical reproducibility, and decision reproducibility relate?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP separate nominal result types and never infer R1 or R2 from exact R0 identity.
decisions.why: Exact bits do not establish numerical tolerance compliance, population adequacy, or decision stability.
decisions.if_kept: Manufactured and exact anchors remain verification evidence while unresolved population or model-form evidence stays unresolved.
decisions.if_changed: Result schemas, canonical bytes, procedure boundaries, and false-elimination tests require a versioned redesign.

decisions.title: Complete crossed evidence with explicit dependence
decisions.question: How should reconstruction, case, stratum, missingness, pairing, and provenance remain visible?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP the complete arm by producer-independent reconstruction by B-02A canonical-case graph and require explicit shared-dependency disclosures.
decisions.why: Dropping coordinates or flattening labels would erase interactions, heteroscedasticity, missingness, and dependence needed to prevent false elimination.
decisions.if_kept: Every registered case, stratum, reference realization, pairing role, representation, execution, and provenance identity remains auditable.
decisions.if_changed: Graph identity, dependency validation, canonical ordering, and statistical fixture coverage require a schema migration.

decisions.title: Six separate evidence-factor classes
decisions.question: Should component uncertainty evidence be stored as one additive budget?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP all six required evidence factors separate and allow combination only inside an injected qualified procedure.
decisions.why: Different labels do not prove independence, and diagnostic components cannot authorize an aggregation rule.
decisions.if_kept: Reference, witness, floor, generator, reconstruction, and finite-case contributions stay inspectable without implied covariance.
decisions.if_changed: Factor schema, decision protocol, uncertainty tests, and B-GATE coverage evidence require prospective revision.

decisions.title: Joint conservative then exact qualified shortcut
decisions.question: How should the harness choose a decision procedure without inventing a dependence model?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP applicable joint propagation first, conservative bounds second, and shortcut procedures only under an exact B-05 assumption, applicability-test, Dossier, evidence-set, and scope match.
decisions.why: Default quadrature, independence, or zero covariance would manufacture scientific authority and can understate uncertainty.
decisions.if_kept: Missing or mismatched qualification fails closed to indeterminate rather than forcing a winner.
decisions.if_changed: Procedure qualification, applicability identity, B-05 shortcut binding, and decision-order tests require a versioned change.

decisions.title: Wrap B-05 staged reconstruction evidence
decisions.question: How should complete-base, repeat, reuse, audit, scientific stopping, and heuristic stopping remain distinct?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP B-05 assessment as the evidence authority and add an ordered audit record whose pre-base and heuristic stops return only EVIDENCE_DEFERRED.
decisions.why: Resource or quality screens cannot become candidate physics failure or deny the registered scientific base evidence.
decisions.if_kept: Scientific sequential actions require exact injected stopping and error-control authority; heuristic futility stays non-scientific.
decisions.if_changed: Campaign result identity, stage audit, B-05 integration, and false-elimination tests require prospective migration.

decisions.title: Structural TEST_ONLY maturity ceiling
decisions.question: Where may synthetic numerical values and procedures exist?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP synthetic numbers and decision rules in deterministic tests only, with runtime fixture-origin checks and no production or LIVE mode.
decisions.why: The ticket authorizes engineering mechanics but reserves every real scientific and production value to human owners.
decisions.if_kept: B-E1 can earn bounded SPECIFIED, IMPLEMENTED, and TESTED without laundering fixture evidence into qualification or ranking.
decisions.if_changed: Maturity records, constructor boundaries, tests, and downstream permitted-use rules require human authority and a prospective schema change.

decisions.title: Wrap B-04 with one exact hostile-response service boundary
decisions.question: How should a registered reference service return outcomes without duplicating or weakening B-04 authority?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP every B-04 identity, grant, outcome, failure, provenance, artifact, and comparison type; WRAP the one-use attempt with a nominal primary/witness hostile-response adapter that emits only ReferenceRunRecord.
decisions.why: A generic result or parallel status ontology could drift from exact registered authority and create an illicit truth path.
decisions.if_kept: B-E4 and B-GATE receive exact deterministic failure evidence while B-04 and candidate-scoring semantics remain unchanged.
decisions.if_changed: The adapter, exact-binding matrix, B-04 seam invariant, fixtures, and downstream failure evidence require prospective migration.

decisions.title: Record retries as separate identity-preserving attempts
decisions.question: How should fixture retry evidence preserve B-04 one-use history without inventing production policy?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP an immutable ordered trace of distinct request/grant/resolution/run attempts with exact idempotency and scientific bindings; never overwrite or aggregate the first failure.
decisions.why: Grant reuse or latest-only projection would erase evidence, while forbidding every future retry would invent operations policy.
decisions.if_kept: Fixtures can prove failure then a separately authorized attempt without authorizing timing, limits, backoff, or fallback.
decisions.if_changed: Attempt-history identity, retry fixtures, reconciliation semantics, and downstream evidence require a versioned change.

decisions.title: Keep failure fixtures non-executable and MMS verification-only
decisions.question: What may a deterministic B-E2 provider response carry or substitute when the registered path fails?
decisions.recommendation: KEEP a closed non-executable response envelope, normalize exception text away, allow no fallback surface, require FIXTURE_ONLY artifacts, and retain MMS only as MANUFACTURED_SOLUTION_VERIFICATION / VERIFICATION_ANCHOR.
decisions.why: Callable, path, cache, weaker-solver, candidate, or relabeled MMS material could launder convenience into scientific authority.
decisions.if_kept: Every malformed, stale, unavailable, timeout, numerical, uncertainty, applicability, and disagreement case remains typed non-candidate evidence.
decisions.if_changed: Provider schema, arbitrary-code and fallback invariants, MMS role tests, and scientific qualification boundaries require human authority and prospective redesign.
